If status==0, skip record. Else diagType=this.GetDiagType(status); if diagType==0 skip record. Else value=this.DTCByte2DTCValue(b0,b1,b2), whose current native shared helper1008ad60 returns(b0<<16)|(b1<<8)|b2. Then if the u32 value at the address stored in command+8 equals1, log and returna0040003; comparison is after frame selection and patch but before this method's share/bus/send calls. Call this.share.GetData(8,&connectionBuffer), local connectionBuffer initializednull. Any error returns unchanged; no additional successful-null check. Call this.cache.CommCacheSndRcvExt(&frame0,u16(0)). NO explicit response clear, no retries/frame iteration in local method. Status in swallowed_statuses returns0, leaves *anyResponse unchanged; other nonzero statuses are logged and returned unchanged. Status0 sets *anyResponse=1 and returns0.
